subject: Application: Cadet Estimator and Project Coordinator, Concrete Seal, Marc Masarate
email_body:
Hello,

I am applying via SEEK for the Cadet Estimator and Project Coordinator role with Concrete Seal in Loganholme.

In February 2026 I finished an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design with road, earthworks, pavement and stormwater design in AutoCAD and Civil 3D. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines (2019). From 2019 to 2020 I worked on site there as project-in-charge and field engineer, including progress records and coordination of daily labour.

I am Melton based, hold a White Card, an Australian driver's licence and own transport, and have full working rights until December 2027 on a Subclass 485 visa. I am open to discussing relocation to South East Queensland. I do not have waterproofing trade experience, and I am ready to learn measured take-offs and tender documentation under your Operations Manager.

Your cadet pathway for civil and construction students into estimating and site coordination is the kind of structured start I want.

I have attached my resume and cover letter. Portfolio: https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio.

Kind regards,
Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com
https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
